metadata.title: Robotics & Autonomous Stewardship
metadata.notes: Comprehensive training for the operators and stewards of the Symtropy platform fleet.

nodes.title: Bipedal & Rugged Locomotion
nodes.description: Mechanics of the 'Humanoid' and 'Quadruped' platforms. Balance homeostasis, center-of-mass (CoM) optimization, and terrain-adaptive gait planning using FEP.

nodes.title: Subsurface Boring & Pressure Sealing
nodes.description: Operating the 'Subterranean' and 'Vault' platforms. Boring through dense friction regimes, managing spoil-removal, and implementing geopolymer vacuum sealing for habitats.

nodes.title: Autonomous Recovery & Fracture Physics
nodes.description: Managing the 'Scavenger' and 'Detritivore' fleets. Non-destructive teardown, fracture-point detection, and high-efficiency material sorting for local recycling loops.

nodes.title: In-Space Assembly & Truss Weaving
nodes.description: The 'Spindle' and 'Cycler' regimes. Brachiating locomotion in zero-G, carbon-fiber composite extrusion, and laser-welding massive orbital solar arrays.

nodes.title: Fluid-Coupled Harbor Swarms
nodes.description: Commanding the 'Pilot' and 'Stevedore' platforms. Precision multi-agent maneuvering of high-inertia cargo (Leviathan) in tidal and wind-shear environments.

nodes.title: Metabolic Infrastructure Maintenance
nodes.description: Diagnostics and repair for 'Stratum' (roads) and 'Plexus' (utility manifolds). Using autonomous telemetry to predict fault-points before they occur.

nodes.title: Multi-Platform Swarm Capstone
nodes.description: Coordinate a mixed swarm (e.g. 1 Scavenger, 2 Vectors, 1 Fabricator) to complete a complex assembly task in a high-entropy environment.

holonic_capstone.deliverable: A functioning multi-agent mission plan with verified collision-free execution and 90% energy efficiency.

edges.rationale: Understanding digital fabrication helps identify how to take things apart efficiently.
Swarm coordination requires mastery of individual locomotion regimes.
The industrial loop requires mastery of material recovery.
Platform command vectors are encoded as HDC hypervectors.
